input.body: We are writing to request a review of a $16.50 deduction on order DD-48267 dated 2026-11-07, which was applied with the reason "missing item" (Peanut Butter Bowl). The order ticket for DD-48267 lists the Peanut Butter Bowl, so the item was part of the order as placed [DD-48267:ticket_lists_item]. Our records show the order was ready at 12:52 and picked up at 12:55, a handoff 3 minutes after it was ready [DD-48267:pickup_handoff]. We do not have a record that shows the contents of the bag at handoff, so we are limiting this request to what the ticket and the pickup timing show. Based on this, we respectfully ask that the deduction be reviewed and reversed. Please let us know if any further information would help.
